<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="HGgxUCvzynjRqGD6d1mJ"> <mxGraphModel dx="1791" dy="964" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
skinparam style strictuml
autonumber
actor Director
participant \"DashboardUI : ReactView\" as UI
participant \"ReportController : ExpressAPI\" as Ctrl
database \"PostgreSQL : Database\" as DB

Director -> UI: navigateToDashboard()
UI -> Ctrl: GET /api/reports/dashboard
Ctrl -> Ctrl: verifyAuthToken()
Ctrl -> DB: SELECT sales, inventory_totals
DB --> Ctrl: return ResultSet
Ctrl -> Ctrl: formatDataForCharts()
Ctrl --> UI: 200 OK (JSON Data)
UI -> UI: renderCharts(Data)
UI --> Director: displayDashboard()
@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="bLvvhFlCX3psBY_E-q13-1"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="460" width="834.26" x="8" y="10" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
